## Why this calls the core TTS service
The `piper-audio` extension speaks the Wyoming TCP protocol on port 10200 (used by Home Assistant), not HTTP, so n8n's HTTP Request node cannot reach it.

This template uses the core ODS `tts` service (Kokoro, OpenAI-compatible `/v1/audio/speech` on port 8880) instead. Enable it with `ods enable tts`.
